selection_reason: Among completed causally valid strategy candidates currently available, this is the only recorded specification with positive growth at its declared base-cost case. The record is a current-rank pointer only; it is not a validated strategy, a deployment approval, or a reason to prioritize this family for further research.
known_weaknesses: No sequential selection or confirmation interval was opened because the preregistered gate failed.
Performance becomes negative at 18 and 24 bps.
The top five positive trades contribute 66.92% of positive PnL.
Only 55 trades were observed over the development interval.
The observed daily growth is about 0.2456% of the 1% daily target and is not close to practical-use qualification.
Comparison across current studies is not fully normalized for data window, market set, and cost contract.

component_leaders.reason: The 50%-queue, 3-second-TTL routing gate improved modeled five-second execution drag by +0.200 bp in development, +0.199 bp in validation, and +0.149 bp in confirmation, while remaining unsuitable as a standalone strategy.
